releaseNotes:
• Offline SMS Queueing: holds incoming SMS safely in local Room database when disconnected from internet
• Instant Auto-Sync on Network Reconnection: auto-dispatches queued messages in chronological FIFO order the moment WiFi or mobile network restores
• Live Network & Offline Queue Status Banner on Dashboard & SMS Feed with live auto-sync progress indicator
• Manual Flush Button in Settings and on banners for immediate queue delivery
• Idempotency guarantee: preserved unique event IDs ensure webhooks never receive duplicate transactions upon delayed delivery
• Complete battery-efficient network callback listener with background auto-flush support
